visual.detailed_description: One unlettered figure with two angiographic frames side by side and white overlay text between them.

panels.general_description: Two grayscale angiographic images of the upper abdomen, each showing a dense round mass of radiopaque coils beside the spine.
panels.detailed_description: Left image: grayscale angiographic frame framed in a white border, with vertebral bodies and a faint thin line running vertically, a dense tangled round coil mass in the middle, and a few small coil loops above it. Right image: a wider grayscale angiographic frame with the diaphragm dome at the top, vertebral column, a dense round coil mass, smaller looped coils above it, a thin curved radiopaque line running down and to the right, and a dark gas-filled shape at lower right. Between and around the two images is white-on-black overlay text: a numeric identifier string, a calendar date and a clock time, the letters L, P and R, and device text including Filt. 5, Shut., Seq: 6 and FRAME = 15 / 27 and a blue Im: 1/24 label at the top of the right image.
